apps.name: I Need Thumb Space
apps.subtitle: One-thumb space exploration, combat, and discovery.
apps.localizedDescription: Pilot a customizable ship through strange sectors, recover unusual modules, and build an archive of everything found between the stars.

versions.localizedDescription: Adds distinct illustrated module art across field recoveries, the Expedition Rack, and Shipyard Vault; introduces a clear preview-and-confirm socket swap with exact displaced-item routing, comparisons, motion, sound, and haptics; fixes the active-vessel preview overlap on large iPhones; and strengthens phone, Duo, landscape, and iPad layout coverage.

Adds the 4x4 Expedition Rack for field loadout decisions; gives recovered modules clear Equip, Pack, and Send choices; safely preserves full-rack overflow in the Vault; improves small-phone recovery and pause layouts; and hardens exact-item saves, swaps, scrapping, resume, and Hardcore loss behavior.

Keeps tutorial, recovery, discovery, and guidance cards out of active minigames; wraps long flight notices into phone-safe cards; keeps timing feedback clear of the ship and interaction panels; and tightens compact-screen text plus Shipyard modal safety.

Turns discovery and loot into a richer hunt with expanded Archive collections, stranger pockets and secrets, clearer phone navigation and flight feedback, cinematic recovered-module reveals, readable gear tradeoffs, and unmistakable Shipyard fit confirmation.

Deepens mining, salvaging, hacking, and Bio Tractor scanning with stronger interaction feedback, NICE / GREAT / PERFECT / CRITICAL chains, escalating timing and combo challenges, dangerous signal spikes, rare flawless rewards, and three strange new Wandering Well destinations.

Adds a visual Bio Atlas with specimen silhouettes and collection progress, clearer field loot reveals with installed-gear comparisons and immediate installs, plus a compact five-slot loadout board and phone-first Module Vault cards.

Adds tractor-beam xenolife capture, a phone-first Module Vault with compact inventory trays and selected-item detail, durable Flight School graduation, scroll-safe Shipyard controls, and cleaner startup/transmission layouts.

Adds escalating multi-module cache reveals, clearer recovered-module quality and tuning ranges, and phone-first loadout socket cards, plus honest Hardcore cargo warnings, long-name layout fixes, and reliable Starter Design saving.
Adds the ramping Cinder Torch, chaining Arc Repeater, and homing Gravekite Rack, plus reliable one-finger Shipyard scrolling, clearer phone layouts and tutorials, and audio and pause cleanup.
